verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page states almost verbatim that Copilot code review can analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements right from your phone. Copilot docs add that its feedback includes suggested changes you can apply with a couple of clicks. Assigning issues to Copilot and iterating on the resulting PRs on mobile further supports the agent workflow. Missing for 10: mobile-specific how-to documentation for requesting and applying Copilot reviews in the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI review feature on mobile.
